algorithm: Validate original pinned normalized index hash and unique original anchor
Build expected source only from original pinned source plus exact one-line insertion
Compare complete normalized current index with expected; keep every DOM/attribute/old tag/outside byte frozen

batchRecommendation: One bounded authorization covering five Save branches and two Index branches; each caller authority and protection stays distinct.

runnerPlan.mainMode: standalone for all five; exported main is not exported run()
runnerPlan.registry: One of five is presently registered; add four reviewed entries only if CLI use is authorized, or explicit reviewed API specs; do not assume support from equal hashes.
runnerPlan.capturePathConstraint: Current API accepts docs/test-infrastructure-sprint-0.1-*.json. Reuse with new phase-b/run IDs and link from PhaseB report; widening prefix requires explicit separate scope.
runnerPlan.limits: Five PhaseB per-suite historical full limits 180000ms/30000000 bytes; keep explicit nested Git8MiB; no global change/full manifest invocation.
runnerPlan.dependencies: Declare original helper/root sources including index.html, Save, Source adapter and suite/runner/checker hashes.

wordingReview.issue: PhaseA pre-write table says Source branch detached serialization/validation. Existing R6 v1 also validates ordinary raw metadata before the unchanged literal writer.
wordingReview.recommendation: Authorize reuse of exact v1 including ordinary metadata validation; detached Source serialization stays Source branch only. Removing the ordinary raw guard is NOT AUTHORIZED by this review.

unsupportedAlternatives.proposal: Current Save/index full-file whitelist, drop freeze, new arbitrary module or consumer, change pins/fixtures/seeds
Automatically include every Source module or claim all runtime inputs are non-interfering
Disable ordinary raw metadata validation under an only-Source wording interpretation

stopConditions: Different pinned bytes/hash or extra index delta
Mutation checker accepts any unrelated source/wiring change
Different/new error during future complete suite run; stop and capture without broadening scope
